ontology.name: Food-Health-Viz Ontology
sources: Salt Lake County Health Department (SLCHD) food inspection portal
University of California San Diego (UCSD) Google Local dataset (Utah subset)
ontology.note: Column-level meaning and enums live in data_dictionary.json, keyed table.column. This file is structure only: classes, relationships, and cross-cutting reasoning guidance.

Establishment.description: A Google Local place in Utah tagged as food-related. Most have no SLCHD inspection history.

SLCHDListing.description: A food service establishment in Salt Lake County

EstablishmentAttribute.description: A free-text feature/amenity tag for an Establishment.

OperatingHours.description: One day's open/close span for an Establishment. A missing day means closed, not missing data.

Review.description: A Google Local user review for an Establishment.

InspectionType.description: Lookup for the SLCHD inspection-type code.

ViolationCode.description: One distinct raw SLCHD violation code.

Violation.description: One cited violation line on an inspection. Zero citations = zero rows, not a placeholder row.

ViolationPublicHealthRationale.description: Raw rubric label as scraped (violations.violation_phr; "phr" = public health rationale). Kept for traceability; map to ViolationType for reasoning.

ViolationType.description: Normalized violation bucket for agent reasoning. Not a stored column — join violations.violation_phr against semantic/violation_map.csv.

InspectionTrend.description: Trend over an SLCHDListing's inspection history. Compute on demand, not stored.

derivation.score_delta: last_score - first_score, ordered by inspection_date within slchd_establishment_key
derivation.improving: score_delta < -9 (bottom quartile, n=1118 establishments with >=2 inspections)

Hypothesis.description: Candidate explanation the agent generates about an establishment.

Evidence.description: A traceable fact or retrieved chunk cited for or against a Hypothesis.

safe_bet: no critical ViolationCode on last 1-2 inspections
health_risk_concern: ViolationCode.critical = true on most recent inspection
inspection_score elevated on most recent visit
violation_occurrences > 1 for the same code on one inspection
improving_compliance: Followup (type 2) after a prior high-score inspection, with a lower score
declining_compliance: increasing critical-violation count or new critical codes
inspection_score trending up over last 3 inspections
repeat_critical_violator: same critical violation_code_id across multiple inspection_dates
Critical Item (type 7) or Followup (type 2) present in history
no_inspection_data_available: Establishment.slchd_establishment_key is null — no matchedToSLCHDListing exists
applies to 98.4% of establishments; state this explicitly rather than staying silent on inspection history
well_reviewed: num_of_reviews >= 225 (dataset median — a real sample backing the rating, not a handful of reviews)
does not require an SLCHDListing match; usable for the 98.4% with no inspection data
reputation_inspection_mismatch: but ViolationCode.critical = true on the most recent inspection, or InspectionTrend worsening
limited_track_record: not enough signal to support or undermine any other hypothesis with confidence

data_quality_flags.establishment_inspection_coverage: Only 139/8592 establishments (1.6%) have a matched SLCHDListing. Don't imply inspection history for the rest.
data_quality_flags.zero_violation_inspections: No violation rows for an inspection means clean, not missing data.
data_quality_flags.duplicate_scrape_violations: 173 inspections (2.5%) have a violation_code_id repeated within one inspection — likely duplicate/OCR-artifact scraping, not double citations. Per-inspection violation counts may be inflated for these.
data_quality_flags.geocode_gap: 71/1341 SLCHDListing rows (5.3%) have no lat/lon after Census + Nominatim geocoding.
data_quality_flags.composite_key_collisions: slchd_establishment_key is a derived NAME|ADDRESS|CITY string, not a permit id — a renamed/re-registered same location isn't deduplicated across time.
data_quality_flags.own_scrape_source_has_no_violations: SLCHDListing rows with source=own_scrape (96/1341) never captured violation line items, even where real inspections had violations.
data_quality_flags.asterisk_meaning_unconfirmed: violation_codes.asterisk_count correlates with critical but its official Utah Food Code meaning was not independently verified.
